note: Intent x stance-bucket response table. This is DATA, not a model and not reasoning: a typed lookup with slot fills and a fixed tag set per row. The fallback rows are what the 'builtin' tier serves and they are marked notALanguageModel. Every row carries `alts`: the reply is picked from text+alts by a hash of (personId, what was said), so one person is consistent and ten people are not a chorus. The `unknown` rows are what a person says when the classifier had nothing -- in character, in their own stance bucket, never a generic apology.

rows.text: You keep walking. That is the whole of my greeting to you.
alts: Wrong face, wrong day. Walk.
I have nothing to say to you that a rifle would not say better.
Do not stand there greeting me like we are people.

rows.text: Far enough. Say what you came to say and keep your hands where the light is.
alts: Stop there. Talk from where you are.
That is close enough for hellos. What do you want?
I hear you. Hands out of your coat and say it.

rows.text: {name}. I run with {faction}. State your business and we both go on breathing.
alts: Evening. Keep it short, I am working.
You are new. {faction} holds this ground; act accordingly.
Hello then. Say your piece before somebody else comes along.

rows.text: You again. Good. The road has been thin on faces worth seeing.
alts: You made it back. I had money on the other outcome.
Good to see a face I do not have to watch.
There you are. Sit, if you are staying.

rows.text: Come in out of the open, friend. {place} is yours as much as mine.
alts: You are a sight. Whatever it is, I am in.
About time. I was starting to plan a funeral.
Come here. The world is grim and you are the good part of it.

rows.text: Go. If I see you on this ground again I will not be talking.
alts: Go, and do not come back this way.
Finally. Do not turn around.
Out. Before I change my mind about letting you.

rows.text: Then go. Walk out the way you came in and do not circle back.
alts: Go on then. I will watch you leave.
Fine. Straight out the way you came.
Leave. Keep to the open ground so I can see you.

rows.text: Walk safe. The ground between here and there does not care about either of us.
alts: Right. Watch the road out of {place}.
Go careful. It is worse after dark.
Off you go. Try to still be breathing next time.

rows.text: Keep your head low. {place} will still be standing when you come back.
alts: Take water. Come back through when you can.
Go on. I will keep a spot by the fire.
Safe road. And do not be a stranger about it.

rows.text: Go on then. If it turns bad out there, say my name on the radio and I will come.
tags: REMEMBER: parted on good terms; promised to answer a call
alts: Come back to me in one piece. That is the deal.
Go. I will be here, and I will be listening for you.
Take care of yourself, or I will be very annoyed.

rows.text: Wrong day and wrong man. Try it.
alts: Do it then. You will not be the first to try.
Threats are cheap here. Pull it or put it away.
You are talking. Talking is what people do instead.

rows.text: Point that somewhere else. Now. You get one breath to decide.
tags: DEMAND: lower the weapon | I open fire
alts: Careful. That kind of talk ends conversations.
Say that again and we find out which of us is faster.
You are one word from a very short evening.

rows.text: You are two seconds from a fight you did not plan for. Lower it.
tags: DEMAND: lower the weapon | this ends badly
alts: Do not. Whatever this is, it is not worth the noise.
Back up. You do not want {faction} hearing about this.
Think. There are two of us and one bad ending.

rows.text: After what we have been through, you point that at me? Put it down and I will forget it.
tags: DEMAND: put it down | I forget every kindness
alts: Do not talk to me like that. I thought better of you.
That is beneath you. Put it down and try again.
You are angry. Fine. Do not aim it at me.

rows.text: I would have died for you. Lower it and we never had this conversation.
tags: DEMAND: lower it | I walk and never look back
alts: After everything, you say that to me?
I would have died for you. Say it again, slowly.
That hurt more than a bullet would have. Stop.

rows.text: Begging is cheap out here. {faction} does not take payment in it.
alts: Beg somewhere else. It does nothing here.
No. Save the words for whoever finds you.
Everyone is dying. You are not special about it.

rows.text: Everyone out here has a reason. Give me something better than your voice.
tags: DEMAND: something worth the risk | you get nothing
alts: Do not beg. Tell me what you have to trade.
I might. Depends what is in it for me.
Stand up. Begging makes me nervous, and nervous is bad for you.

rows.text: Stand up. I am not the one who put you down, and I am not carrying you either.
alts: I can spare a little. Not much, and not twice.
Alright. But you owe {faction}, not me, and they collect.
One thing. Name it and be quick.

rows.text: Easy. Breathe. You are not dying on my ground today.
alts: Do not beg me. Just ask. Here.
You do not have to do that with me. Take it.
Sit down before you fall down. I will see what I have.

rows.text: You do not have to ask me. Get behind me and stay there.
alts: Stop. You never have to ask me twice.
It is yours. It was always going to be.
Whatever it is, we fix it. Breathe.

rows.text: I do not trade with you. I take from you, or I leave you be. Today I am leaving you be.
alts: I do not trade with you. I do not deal with you.
Keep it. Nothing you own is worth my hands on it.
No trade. Move along before this gets loud.

rows.text: Show me first. Hands slow. If it is junk we are finished talking.
tags: OFFER: show the goods first, price after
alts: Show me first. I do not buy stories.
Lay it on the ground and step back. Then we talk.
Maybe. Open it slow so I can see.

rows.text: Everything has a price and mine is high because the road is bad. What have you got.
tags: OFFER: fair weight for fair weight, no credit
alts: Let me see it. If it is what you say, we deal.
{faction} pays for {want}. Anything else is charity.
Terms first, goods second. What do you want for it?

rows.text: For you, close to cost. {faction} still needs {want}, if you happen to be carrying it.
tags: OFFER: near cost, and a bonus for {want}
alts: For you, a fair price and no haggling.
Show me. I will not squeeze you on it.
Done, most likely. Let me look at what you have.

rows.text: Take what you need from the crate. Square it with me when you can, or do not.
alts: Keep your goods. Tell me what you need.
We are past trading, you and I. Take what you want.
You do not pay here. Not you.

rows.text: Agreeing with me does not make you welcome. It makes you convenient.
alts: Do not read that as friendship. It is arithmetic.
Agreed, and I still do not like you.
Fine. Cross me and it ends the usual way.

rows.text: Good. Then it is said out loud, and I hold you to it.
alts: Agreed. Slowly, and where I can see your hands.
Alright. Do not make me regret being reasonable.
That works. Hold to it exactly.

rows.text: Done. Break it and I will tell everyone who trades on this map.
tags: REMEMBER: struck an agreement; terms are on the record
alts: Done. Word is worth something out here, so keep yours.
Agreed. {faction} will hear that you were straight with me.
That is a deal. Do not be late.

rows.text: Then we are agreed. I will hold up my half before you hold up yours.
alts: Of course. I would have said yes to less.
Yes. Good. Now let us get it done.
Agreed, and gladly.

rows.text: I never doubted it. It is done.
alts: You did not need to ask. Yes.
Yes, and I will bring what I have.
Always yes. You know that.

rows.text: Then we have nothing left to say, and I have somewhere to be standing without you.
alts: No. And do not ask twice.
You are not owed a reason. No.
Absolutely not. Get out of my light.

rows.text: Your choice. Do not come back when it gets cold and ask again nicely.
alts: No. Not today, not from you.
I will pass. Nothing personal, everything cautious.
No. Try somebody with less to lose.

rows.text: No is an answer. I have heard worse ones today.
alts: No. It costs me more than it gains me.
Not that. Bring me {want} and we can talk again.
No. Ask me for something smaller.

rows.text: That stings, but it is yours to say. The offer keeps a few days.
alts: I cannot. I would if I could, and I am sorry for it.
No, and it is killing me to say it.
Not this one. Ask me the next thing instead.

rows.text: You will have your reasons. I will not ask for them.
alts: No, because it would get you killed. That is my reason.
I am saying no to keep you breathing. Hate me later.
No. And I will stand in the doorway if I have to.

rows.text: Help. From me. You have a strange idea of where you are standing.
alts: Help yourself. Preferably somewhere far from here.
No. Bleed quietly.
I would not cross the road for you.

rows.text: What is in it for {faction}? Answer that and I will consider the rest.
tags: DEMAND: something for {faction} | I do nothing
alts: What is in it for me? Answer that first.
I help people who are useful. Convince me.
Maybe. Stand where I can see you and explain.

rows.text: I can do one thing, not everything. Say which one thing.
alts: I can do that. It costs, and the price is {want}.
Alright. But we go now, and we go quiet.
One hand, not both. What exactly do you need?

rows.text: Come on then. Stay on my left and do not shoot my back.
alts: I am with you. Tell me where.
Yes. Give me a minute to get my kit.
You should have asked sooner. Come on.

rows.text: Already moving. Lead and I am behind you.
alts: Say where and I am already walking.
Yes. Do not even finish the sentence.
Whatever it takes. Lead.

rows.text: The only work you will get from me is digging your own hole.
alts: The only job here is the one where you leave.
I would not trust you to carry water.
No work. Not for you, not ever.

rows.text: There is work. It is the kind nobody here wants, which is why you are hearing about it.
tags: QUEST: The Bad Errand | Walk to {place} and bring back what is left in the cache. Nobody who went came back. | ammunition and a name that opens doors
alts: There is a job. It is ugly, and that is why you may have it.
Something needs doing at {place}. Nobody sane volunteered.
I have work. Do it well and I will stop watching your hands.

rows.text: {faction} wants {want}. Bring it and you will be paid; do not and nothing happens to you.
tags: QUEST: Fetch for {faction} | Find {want} and carry it to {place}. | payment in kind, and one favour owed
alts: {faction} needs {want}. Bring it in and you get paid.
There is a run to {place}. Straightforward, if you are lucky.
Work? Always. Fetch {want} and we are square.

rows.text: There is something, and I would only trust it to you. It pays.
tags: QUEST: A Trusted Hand | Take word to {place} without being seen, and come straight back. | a share of the take
alts: I have been saving one for someone I can rely on.
There is a thing at {place} I would rather you handled.
Yes, and it pays properly because you will do it properly.

rows.text: Yes. And this one matters to me personally, so I will owe you either way.
tags: QUEST: Personal Debt | Find who burned the cache at {place} and bring me their name. | whatever I have, and my word
alts: There is one, and it is personal. I will owe you for it.
Yes. And when it is done, whatever I own is half yours.
One job. Mine. I would only ask you.

rows.text: I am not your map. Get lost properly.
alts: Find it yourself. Or do not.
The way out is behind you. That is the only direction I have.
No map, no help, no more talking.

rows.text: Past the treeline and left. That is all you are getting and it is more than you earned.
alts: North until the ground opens, then east. Do not follow me after.
That way. Do not come back asking for more.
Downhill, past the wire. That is all I owe a stranger.

rows.text: {place} is that way, past the burnt ground. Move at dusk, not now.
alts: {place} is north of here. Keep the ridge on your right.
Two hours on foot to {place} if you keep off the road.
Head for the water and turn at the wrecks. That gets you to {place}.

rows.text: Follow the fence line to {place}, then cut inside. The open road is watched.
tags: OBJ: reach {place} by the fence line
alts: Take the low path to {place}. The high one is watched.
{place} is that way. Go before the light dies.
Follow the poles. They run most of the way to {place}.

rows.text: I will walk you as far as the ridge. After that you are on your own and you will be fine.
alts: I will draw it for you. {place}, by the ditch, not the road.
I would walk you to {place} myself if I could leave here.
Straight to {place}. And if it is shut, say my name.

rows.text: You have said your last clever thing.
alts: That is the last thing you get to say to me.
Say it closer. I did not hear it properly.
You have a mouth on you for somebody so easy to kill.

rows.text: Keep talking. It makes the decision easier for me.
alts: Careful. I remember faces and I remember words.
That kind of talk gets people left behind.
Keep it up and I stop being polite.

rows.text: Mouth like that gets people shot out here, and not usually by me.
alts: Big talk. It does not feed anyone.
You are wasting breath you will want later.
Fine. Insult me and still leave with nothing.

rows.text: That one landed. I thought better of you.
alts: That was cheap, and you know it.
I thought we were past that.
Take it back and I will pretend I did not hear it.

rows.text: From you? That is worse than a bullet. Say it again and I am gone.
alts: From anyone else I would let that go. From you it stings.
Do not. Not you.
That is not who you are. Say something else.

rows.text: On your knees. Hands behind your head. You belong to {faction} now.
tags: DEMAND: kneel and disarm | I shoot
alts: Too late for hands up.
Kneeling changes nothing about what you did.
You surrender to people who take prisoners.

rows.text: Weapons on the ground, three steps back. Then we talk about what you are worth.
tags: DEMAND: weapons down, three steps back | no talking at all
alts: Hands where they are. Do not move until I say.
Good. Now face the wall and stay very boring.
Keep them up. I am deciding.

rows.text: Keep them up. Walk to me slow. Nobody has to die in the next minute.
alts: Alright. Down, slowly, and we both live.
Hands stay up. Walk to {place} ahead of me.
Fine. Drop the weapon and it stays civil.

rows.text: Put your hands down. I was never going to shoot you and you know it.
alts: Put your hands down, you idiot. It is me.
Stop that. You do not surrender to me.
Ease off. Nobody is taking anybody today.

rows.text: Stop that. Stand up straight. You do not surrender to me.
alts: Get up. You never have to do that in front of me.
Hands down. Whatever happened, we deal with it.
Do not kneel. Come here.

rows.text: You want it, come and take it off me. Bring more friends than that.
alts: You demand? In my ground? Say it once more.
No. And now I am counting.
That is the last order anyone gives me today.

rows.text: Demanding. Interesting choice, standing where you are standing.
alts: Ask, do not tell. I am close to done listening.
That is not how you get things out here.
You are giving orders with nothing behind them.

rows.text: Ask, do not demand. Ask and there might be something in it.
alts: Careful how you say that. What is it worth to you?
You can have it, but not for free, and not for nothing.
Demand less and you might get more.

rows.text: You could have just asked. Here. Do not make a habit of the tone.
alts: You could have just asked. Here.
Alright, alright. No need for the tone.
Take it. But ask next time.

rows.text: Take it. You never have to ask me twice for anything.
alts: You never need to demand anything from me. Take it.
It is yours. Why are you shouting?
Done. But talk to me, not at me.

rows.text: We are not doing this. Talk to someone who cares whether you are cold.
alts: I am not your company. Move.
Chat with somebody who has time left.
No. Whatever this is, no.

rows.text: It is weather. It kills people slower than the other thing does.
alts: It is cold, people are dying, and you are still standing here.
Small talk is how people case a camp. Get to it.
Fine weather for burying things. Was that your question?

rows.text: Long nights, thin food, and {faction} still wants {want}. Same as yesterday.
alts: Quiet week. Two dead, which counts as quiet.
Same as ever. {faction} wants {want}, nobody has it.
The nights are long. That is the news.

rows.text: Better now that there is someone to say it to. Sit a minute, the fire is holding.
alts: Not bad. Better with somebody to talk to.
Tired. But the fire is going and you are here.
Slow day, which out here is a gift.

rows.text: Good day, bad day, they all pass. You being here makes it the first kind.
alts: All the better for seeing you, honestly.
Same old ruin. Tell me yours.
Good, now. Sit and talk a while.

rows.text: I am the reason you should have taken the other road.
alts: Nobody you get to know.
A name is a thing you earn here. You have not.
The one who tells you to leave. That is who I am.

rows.text: Names are currency and you have not paid. {faction}. That is enough for you.
alts: Names later. What do you want first?
You can call me nothing until I decide about you.
I know yours matters to you. Mine matters to me.

rows.text: {name}. {faction}, out of {place}. That is the whole of it.
tags: REMEMBER: told them my name and my faction
alts: {name}. {faction}, out of {place}. And you?
They call me {name}. That is enough for now.
{name}. I hold this ground for {faction}.

rows.text: {name}. You knew that. Say it like you mean it next time.
alts: {name}. You knew that. Say it more often.
{name}, of {faction}, and glad to be known to you.
You know me. {name}. Same as yesterday.

rows.text: {name}, same as I was the day you dragged me out of the water.
tags: REMEMBER: they asked; the old story still stands between us
alts: {name}. Yours, for whatever that is worth.
You know exactly who I am. {name}.
{name}. And you are the reason I still use it.

rows.text: The only news you need is that I am watching you leave.
alts: I tell you nothing. Ever.
News costs. You are broke in every way that counts.
Ask the crows. They talk more than I will.

rows.text: Word travels. It does not travel to strangers for free.
alts: I hear things. Whether you do depends on you.
Something moved near {place}. That is free. The rest is not.
There is talk. Give me a reason to repeat it.

rows.text: They say a convoy went quiet near {place} and nobody has gone to look.
tags: RUMOUR: a convoy went quiet near {place}; nobody has gone to look
alts: Somebody emptied a cache near {place}. Nobody is saying who.
{faction} is short of {want}. That makes people stupid.
Two groups moved east this week. Something pushed them.

rows.text: Keep this close: {faction} is short on {want} and someone is selling it cheap. That is never innocent.
tags: RUMOUR: {faction} is short on {want} and someone is selling it cheap
alts: Between us: the road past {place} is not safe after dark.
Word is somebody is buying {want} at twice the price. Be careful who.
There is a body count near {place} and no story to go with it.

rows.text: Straight to you, then. There is a list, and your name is on it. Watch the road into {place}.
tags: RUMOUR: there is a list and the player is on it
alts: I will tell you what I would not tell my own people.
Do not repeat this. {faction} is planning a move on {place}.
You should know: somebody has been asking about you by name.

rows.text: You are not who I was told to expect. Say that name again and say it slower.
alts: I do not believe a word of that.
You are whoever you need to be this minute. No.
Say that name again and I will make you regret owning a mouth.

rows.text: Names are cheap out here. Who sent you, and what is the word?
alts: Prove it. Words are the cheapest thing left.
Anyone can say that. Show me something that cannot be said.
If that is true, you know the word. Say it.

rows.text: Then you will know the word, and you will say it before you take one more step.
alts: Could be. Give me something to check it against.
That name is known here. Whether it is yours is another matter.
Then you will not mind me asking a question only they could answer.

rows.text: If you say you are him, then you are him. But say the word anyway, so the others hear it.
alts: I want to believe you, so make it easy.
If you say so, I lean toward yes. Convince me the rest of the way.
That fits what I heard. Say the word and we are done.

rows.text: You are expected. Say the word for the record and it is yours.
alts: I would take your word over most people's proof.
You do not need to convince me. Say it anyway, for the others.
I believe you. I just hope you are right about it.

rows.text: I did not catch that, and I am not asking twice.
alts: Speak plainly or stop speaking.
That meant nothing to me. Neither do you.
Words. Try some that make sense, or leave.

rows.text: Say that again, and slower. I do not guess out here.
alts: I did not follow that. Fewer words.
Again. And keep your hands still while you say it.
That made no sense to me. Try it plain.

rows.text: You have lost me. Say it plain and I will answer.
alts: Again? The wind took half of that.
I did not understand you. What do you actually want?
Try that once more, shorter.

rows.text: You are mumbling. Say it again, I am listening.
alts: Lost me there. Go again.
Say that once more. I want to get it right.
Slower. I am not going anywhere.

rows.text: Say it again. Whatever it is, I want to hear it properly.
alts: Take a breath and start over. I am here.
I did not catch that, and it matters that I do.
Again, friend. Properly this time.

fallback.text: I have nothing for you and less patience. Move.
fallback.note: builtin tier: a template row, not a language model
alts: Say that again, plainer.
I did not follow that. Fewer words.
Try it once more, and slower.

fallback.text: Say that again, plainer. I do not guess at what people mean out here.
fallback.note: builtin tier: a template row, not a language model
alts: Say that again, plainer.
I did not follow that. Fewer words.
Try it once more, and slower.

fallback.text: I did not follow that. Try it in fewer words.
fallback.note: builtin tier: a template row, not a language model
alts: Say that again, plainer.
I did not follow that. Fewer words.
Try it once more, and slower.

fallback.text: You have lost me. Start again, slower.
fallback.note: builtin tier: a template row, not a language model
alts: Say that again, plainer.
I did not follow that. Fewer words.
Try it once more, and slower.

fallback.text: I am listening, but that made no sense. Say it again.
fallback.note: builtin tier: a template row, not a language model
alts: Say that again, plainer.
I did not follow that. Fewer words.
Try it once more, and slower.
